book.title: 垃圾车把垃圾送到哪里
book.subtitle: 清晨路线上的分类接力
book.question: 垃圾车把垃圾送到哪里？

moral.zh: 垃圾会沿着分类、收集、转运和处理的路线前进；每个人分对垃圾，城市就少走弯路。
moral.en: Waste follows a route of sorting, collection, transfer, and treatment. Sorting correctly helps the whole city.

pages.zhText: 天刚亮，安安在小区门口看见一辆绿色垃圾车。
pages.enText: At dawn, An'an saw a green garbage truck at the entrance to her neighborhood.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Fresh dawn neighborhood wide shot: a clean green municipal garbage truck arrives at a marked collection point, An'an and Mom watch from the sidewalk, tidy bins, no overflowing mess or logos.

pages.zhText: 她问：“垃圾车把这些东西都带到哪里去呢？”
pages.enText: She asked, “Where does the garbage truck take all these things?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium view of An'an peeking curiously at several colored bins while Mom points toward the truck, bins have simple colored shapes only and no readable words, safe distance.

pages.zhText: 妈妈说：“第一步，是把不同种类放进对应的桶里。”
pages.enText: Mom said, “The first step is putting different kinds into the right bins.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Child-friendly sorting scene: An'an places a clean paper carton into a paper-recycling bin while Mom supervises; nearby food scraps and a small battery are represented by clear objects in separate bins, no text.

pages.zhText: 环卫叔叔检查桶边，确认没有尖锐物露在外面。
pages.enText: The sanitation worker checked the bins to make sure no sharp objects were sticking out.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Worker in gloves safely checks closed bins beside the truck while An'an and Mom stand behind a low boundary, no sharp object close-up, no danger, warm morning light.

pages.zhText: 机械臂轻轻抬起一只桶，把里面的东西倒进车厢。
pages.enText: A mechanical arm gently lifted one bin and tipped its contents into the truck compartment.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Detailed but safe side view of a garbage truck's hydraulic arm lifting a closed-lid bin into the rear hopper, worker controls it from a safe position, An'an observes wide-eyed, no debris flying.

pages.zhText: 车厢里的压缩板慢慢移动，把松松的垃圾压得更紧。
pages.enText: Inside the compartment, a compactor slowly moved and made the loose waste take up less space.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Cutaway-style educational view of the truck's rear compactor plate gently compressing clean stylized shapes inside a sealed compartment, no smell or hazardous contents, An'an sees a safe diagram-like glimpse, no labels.

pages.zhText: 安安发现：压紧以后，车厢能装下更多，还不用来回跑很多趟。
pages.enText: An'an discovered that compacting leaves room for more, so the truck needs fewer trips.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Playful comparison in one scene: a transparent visual of a roomy compacted load beside a loosely filled load, with the same truck and An'an measuring with her hands, no split-panel borders or text.

pages.zhText: 垃圾车沿着清晨路线前进，先去几个小区，再到转运站。
pages.enText: The truck followed its morning route, visiting several neighborhoods before heading to a transfer station.
pages.illustrationPrompt: High gentle route view: same green truck travels from one tidy neighborhood to another along a curved city road toward a clean transfer station, An'an and Mom wave from a sidewalk, no readable signs.

pages.zhText: 在转运站，垃圾被重新检查，再装进更大的运输车。
pages.enText: At the transfer station, the waste was checked again and loaded into a larger transport vehicle.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Clean transfer station scene: workers in safety gear inspect sorted covered containers and move them with equipment toward a larger covered truck, An'an and Mom remain behind a visitor line, no mess or text.

pages.zhText: 可回收的材料会去再利用；其他垃圾也要按规定处理。
pages.enText: Recyclable materials can be used again, and other waste is treated according to safety rules.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Hopeful educational facility view: neat streams of paper, metal, and glass shapes head toward recycling equipment while sealed residual bins go another way, no labels, no smoke, no dangerous machinery exposure.

pages.zhText: 安安把纸盒压扁、把垃圾分好，给清晨路线少添一点麻烦。
pages.enText: An'an flattened her carton and sorted her waste, making the morning route a little easier.
pages.illustrationPrompt: At home recycling corner, An'an flattens a clean carton and sorts items with Mom; a tiny drawing of the green truck is on a blank paper, cozy light, no text, safe household scene.

pages.zhText: 街道变得清爽了。安安又问：“洒水车为什么一路喷水呢？”
pages.enText: The street felt fresh and clear. An'an asked, “Why does a water truck spray water along the road?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing sunny street: clean curb and green garbage truck returning to its depot in the distance; An'an and Mom notice a water truck farther ahead, inviting the next story, no dirt exaggeration or text.

imagePromptKit.globalStyle: Premium warm 3D clay-like animated-film children's picture-book illustration, tactile rounded materials, lively but uncluttered modern city, accurate friendly municipal vehicles, varied cinematic camera angles, square composition, coherent visual continuity across every page.
imagePromptKit.characterConsistency: Keep An'an identical on every page: a six-year-old Chinese girl with a round face, ear-length straight black bob, yellow star hair clip, teal-green hooded jacket, blue jeans, orange small backpack, and white sneakers with red trim. Mom is a calm secondary adult in a coral cardigan and cream trousers; keep An'an as the visual focus.
imagePromptKit.negative: No text, letters, captions, labels, logos, brand marks, readable license plates, watermarks, overflowing waste, exposed sharp objects, child touching machinery, unsafe proximity to trucks, smoke, fire, duplicated characters, distorted anatomy, or anthropomorphic vehicle faces.
